{{Infobox auto|type=[[Fish]]}}
A '''creaking fish''' is a rare ⭐⭐⭐☆ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in the [[Fishing#Special biomes|Pale Garden]] biome. It cooks into [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys 2 of them for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The creaking fish can be caught in this table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/pale_garden.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Special biomes|Pale Garden]] || Pale Garden || 7 of 39 || 15.26% || 16.06% || 15.17%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Raw fish can be eaten, but it heals nothing: Matcha Flavoured removes [[hunger]], and food only heals through the hearts shown on its tooltip. Cooked, it becomes [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], which heals {{Hp|4}}.

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Creaking Fish|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Creaking Fish|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Creaking Fish|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:cod</code>, so every small fish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_cod.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
Because it is a cod underneath, it can be used wherever a raw cod is accepted: the [[Green Curry Stock|green curry stock]] recipe takes any cod or salmon.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/uncooked_green_curry.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 2 caught creaking fish for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Master level. Only fish caught by fishing (with the ⭐⭐⭐☆ line) are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/5/pale_fish.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for the creaking fish under Pale Garden (listed chance 25%), unlocked by catching one while the almanac tab is open.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A pale fish from the Pale Garden that looks like it hasn't seen sunlight since the beginning of time.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.

== Trivia ==
* The fish is a <code>minecraft:cod</code> item with the name, texture (<code>matcha:pale_fish</code>) and rarity line set by its loot table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/fish/pale_fish.json}}</ref>
* Its internal ID is <code>pale_fish</code>. It is the only ⭐⭐⭐☆ fish that plays the ⭐⭐⭐⭐ [[fishing sounds|catch sound]], and the Fisherman only buys it at Master level, 2 for an Obol.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/4_star.json}}</ref>
* The almanac lists its chance as 25%, but its actual share of the Pale Garden table is 17.95%.
